purpose: Close the workspace-wide evasion of `clippy::map_err_ignore = "deny"`: the lint only matches the bare `|_|` closure spelling, but the codebase converged on `|_error|`/`|_err|`/`|_e|`/`|_ident|` (42 sites across 16 files in 7 crates), which discards the real cause identically while passing the existing guard rail. Add a CI/`just lint` gate that rejects the evasion spelling, and give the handful of sibling error types that structurally cannot hold a cause (VcsError::Git(String), LocateError::MoonUnavailable, and others) a #[source] slot.
scope: Workspace-wide lint boundary: a new `.github/tests/verify-error-erasure-gate.sh` script wired into `just lint` and the `Workflow Contracts` CI job, rejecting `map_err(\s*|_[A-Za-z_]` and `allow(clippy::map_err_ignore` across crates/**/*.rs. Plus targeted #[source]-slot additions to VcsError, LocateError, ConfigError, ReleasePrDecisionError, and a new GraphError::InvalidPackageId, covering the ~10 sibling sites outside callisto-graph's release path (which is covered by the companion spec SPEC-ARCH-RELEASE-ERROR-TAXONOMY.json instead).
non_goals: Restructuring VcsError::Git(String) itself or migrating its ~65 format!("...: {e}") construction sites to a source chain -- their Display already preserves the cause; only io::Error sites move to a new Io variant.

The 42 map_err_ignore-evading sites inside callisto-graph's release executor (release.rs/release_decision.rs/release_execution.rs): covered by SPEC-ARCH-RELEASE-ERROR-TAXONOMY.json's own architecture-test enforcement, not this gate's initial scope (the gate's regex still catches them, but their remediation is that spec's job).
A dylint/custom-clippy lint or nightly toolchain: the gate is a bash+ripgrep contract script matching this repo's existing .github/tests/*.sh convention.
Enabling clippy::allow_attributes_without_reason workspace-wide (17 unrelated #[allow] sites exist); only allow(clippy::map_err_ignore is rejected by the gate.
Gating other discard shapes (bare `Err(_) =>` match arms, `.unwrap_or_else(|_e|`, `.ok()` on a Result) -- reviewer territory outside GraphError's own required-reason fields.
Changing the --format json / error envelope shape beyond message text.
problem: `clippy::map_err_ignore = "deny"` has been in [workspace.lints.clippy] since early in this codebase's history, but the lint only fires on the literal `|_|` closure pattern. The workspace has 0 such sites and 42 `.map_err(|_error|` / `|_err|` / `|_e|` / `|_parse_err|` sites across 16 files in 7 crates -- the codebase converged on exactly the one spelling that evades the guard rail it turned on. Concrete harmful examples confirmed by direct code reading: crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_execution.rs:46 discards the 5-variant ArtifactManifestError even though GraphError::ArtifactManifest{source} (E136) already exists for it; crates/callisto-cli/src/commands/release_pr.rs:53 discards GitHubRepositoryParseError's 4 distinct rejection reasons behind one 'invalid repository' message naming only the bad string; crates/callisto-vcs/src/release_lock.rs:44 discards a std::io::Error entirely into a fixed string with no #[source] at all, even though this same crate's own convention two lines away preserves the cause via format!("...: {e}"); crates/callisto-moon/src/locator.rs:36 folds a process-spawn failure and a real non-zero exit (with moon's own actionable stderr) into one LocateError::MoonUnavailable whose own doc comment admits the conflation.
why_it_matters: This has already been fixed at least twice by adding a sibling variant after the fact (E136 ArtifactManifest, E157 RegistryPublishUnconfirmed for the npm registry-lag case) -- proof the sink keeps recurring, not that it's been solved. A developer following this file's dominant pattern (`.map_err(|_error| SomeError)`) writes code that looks idiomatic for this repo and passes `just lint` today, silently reintroducing the exact defect the workspace's own lint configuration was meant to prevent. Concretely: a broken moon.yml and a missing moon binary render identically to a user, discarding moon's own stderr that would say which situation they're in; a malformed --repository flag tells the user their string is wrong without saying what about it is wrong; a read-only release-state directory reports 'could not create release state directory' with zero indication of why.
proposal: A single CI/lint gate, not a rewrite of every site by hand. Add `.github/tests/verify-error-erasure-gate.sh` (mirroring the shape of this repo's existing `verify-release-workflow-contract.sh`) that fails when any file under `crates/**/*.rs` matches `map_err\(\s*\|_[A-Za-z_]` (the evasion spelling) or contains `allow(clippy::map_err_ignore`, with a fixture self-test asserting the three expected exit codes (evasion present -> fail, allow-attribute present -> fail, a source-preserving map_err or a bare `|_|` under an explicit `#[expect(clippy::map_err_ignore, reason = "...")]` -> pass). Wire it into the `lint` recipe in Justfile and the `Workflow Contracts` job in `.github/workflows/callisto-ci.yml`. This funnels every future erasure attempt onto the bare `|_|` spelling the existing deny lint already catches, with `#[expect(..., reason)]` as the sole, reviewable escape hatch (rustc's `unfulfilled_lint_expectations` under `-D warnings` even catches a stale expect once the erasure is fixed). Separately, give the small number of sibling error types that structurally cannot hold a cause the slot they're missing: VcsError gains an `Io{context: &'static str, #[source] source: std::io::Error}` variant for release_lock.rs's two sites; LocateError::MoonUnavailable is replaced by MoonSpawn{#[source] source: CommandError} and MoonProjectGraphFailed{exit_code, stderr}; ConfigError::InvalidChangelogPath/InvalidChangesetsDir and LocateError::OutsideWorkspaceRoot gain #[source] source: ModelError; ReleasePrDecisionError::InvalidRepository gains #[source] source: GitHubRepositoryParseError; a new GraphError::InvalidPackageId{raw, #[source] source: PackageIdParseError} separates malformed-identifier from unknown-package at publish.rs:574; GraphError::GroupGrammarMismatch gains #[source] source: GrammarMismatch.
outcome: `just lint` and the Workflow Contracts CI job fail on any future `.map_err(|_ident| ...)` or `#[allow(clippy::map_err_ignore)]` anywhere under crates/; `rg 'map_err\(\s*\|_[A-Za-z_]' crates/` returns 0 (from today's 42). The handful of sibling error types that could never carry a cause now can: a moon.yml parse failure surfaces moon's own stderr instead of being indistinguishable from 'moon not installed'; a malformed --repository flag names which part is wrong; a release-state-directory failure surfaces the real io::Error. E124/GraphError::ReleaseIntentStale itself is out of this spec's remediation scope (see the companion spec) but is still caught by the gate's regex, which is why that spec's PR1 must land the architecture-test ratchet before or alongside this gate going live workspace-wide -- otherwise this gate blocks that migration's own in-flight `legacy_unclassified()` substitution sites.
estimated_blast_radius: 1 new script + 1 fixture self-test + 2 CI/Justfile wiring points; ~10 sibling-type edits outside callisto-graph's release path (callisto-vcs/src/lib.rs + release_lock.rs, callisto-moon/src/locator.rs, callisto-graph/src/config/resolve.rs + locate/ignore_walk.rs + commands/publish.rs + cascade.rs, callisto-cli/src/commands/release_pr.rs). Does not touch callisto-graph's release.rs/release_decision.rs/release_execution.rs content -- their 42-site remediation is SPEC-ARCH-RELEASE-ERROR-TAXONOMY.json's job; this spec's gate only needs to not go live in CI before or without coordinating with that migration's ratchet mechanism.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: verify-error-erasure-gate.sh exits non-zero when any file under crates/ matches map_err\(\s*\|_[A-Za-z_] or contains allow(clippy::map_err_ignore, and exits zero otherwise. Its fixture self-test runs the script against three temp trees (evading map_err, allow-attribute present, a source-preserving map_err plus an explicitly-reasoned #[expect] on a bare |_|) and asserts exit codes 1, 1, 0 respectively.

The gate is invoked by the `lint` recipe in Justfile and by a step in the Workflow Contracts job of .github/workflows/callisto-ci.yml; inserting an evading map_err into any crate makes `just lint` fail.
On the fully-migrated tree, `rg -n 'map_err\(\s*\|_[A-Za-z_]' crates/` returns zero matches (baseline: 42), and `map_err_ignore = "deny"` remains in [workspace.lints.clippy] in the root Cargo.toml.

cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings fails when a remaining source-discarding map_err is spelled |_| without #[expect(clippy::map_err_ignore, reason)], and also fails when that attribute is present but the closure no longer discards its argument (rustc's unfulfilled_lint_expectations).

VcsError::Io{context, #[source] source: std::io::Error} exists and ReleaseWorkspaceLock::acquire against an uncreatable parent directory returns it; a Unix-only test with a 0o500 parent asserts source.kind() == PermissionDenied. rg 'map_err\(\|_' crates/callisto-vcs/src returns zero matches.

LocateError::MoonUnavailable no longer exists; MoonProjectLocator::load_graph returns MoonSpawn{source} on a spawn failure and MoonProjectGraphFailed{exit_code, stderr} on a non-zero exit, each verified by a targeted test asserting the real cause is present in the error.

ReleasePrDecisionError::InvalidRepository carries #[source] source: GitHubRepositoryParseError; distinct malformed inputs (too many parts, invalid characters, no separator) assert distinct source variants.

GraphError::InvalidPackageId{raw, #[source] source: PackageIdParseError} is returned for a syntactically malformed --package value, while a well-formed but nonexistent package name still returns the existing GraphError::UnknownPackage.
ConfigError::InvalidChangelogPath/InvalidChangesetsDir and LocateError::OutsideWorkspaceRoot carry #[source] source: ModelError; an absolute changelog path asserts source is ModelError::AbsolutePath.
GraphError::GroupGrammarMismatch carries #[source] source: GrammarMismatch; a cascade group with SemVer and Pep440 members asserts the exact {left, right} pair in the source.

coordination_note: This gate's regex also matches every evading site inside callisto-graph's release executor, which SPEC-ARCH-RELEASE-ERROR-TAXONOMY.json migrates on its own 4-PR ratchet (legacy_unclassified() substitution). Land this gate's CI wiring (AC-002) only after that spec's PR1 lands its own architecture-test allowlist, or the two efforts will fight over the same 42-of-101 release-path sites mid-migration.
reasoning: Produced by a scribe:architect agent inside workflow wf_b20f2ad3-7ca on 2026-09-10, following a dedicated recon pass that enumerated and categorized 40 confirmed error-source-erasure sites workspace-wide by reading each in context (not just grep counting), judging harm per-site rather than padding the count with interchangeable discards.
